card.name: Past-tense verb after a subject
card.fires_on: The main verb or auxiliary right after a subject, mostly in past or present-perfect form such as 'have occurred', 'were administered' or 'lived'. It is seen in label warnings, study descriptions and historical prose.

modes.label: Reported adverse events
modes.description: 'occurred' after 'have' or 'uncommonly' in warnings about reactions.

card.plain: It fires on the past-tense verb that comes right after the subject of a sentence, as in 'reactions have occurred'.
